Incorporating the November 2022 Financial Stability Report, which highlighted persistent inflation pressures, tighter financial conditions, reduced Treasury market liquidity and elevated interest rate volatility, vulnerabilities in nonbank financial intermediation (including money market and bond funds), and global risks from the Russia–Ukraine war, the tone of the FOMC statement is more cautious than the initial -0.25 suggests. Given the commitment to ongoing rate hikes and balance-sheet reduction, I adjust the sentiment slightly more negative.
